statement: Independent scan-only inventory of the middle panel of the 68r foldout: 59 separate stars and two face medallions. No other f68r2 annotation or transcription words were read. The full 7993 by 3828 canvas was inspected at 2200 px width, followed by a direct middle-panel crop and a native-resolution central detail. Neighboring f68r1 and f68r3 drawings are excluded. Only verified ZL locus identifiers were extracted: five paragraph loci, circular loci .6 and .31, and 24 star-label loci .7–.30. Star counts were made from the image, not forced to the number of labels. All label values remain null because no blind coordinate-to-locus key was obtained. Six rays are recorded on three stars clearly resolved in the detail; remaining ray counts are unclear. An unclear centre or colour is unscored uncertainty, not absence of the feature.

provenance.coordinates: Approximate [x,y] centres in the displayed 1200-wide crop (height 2107); origin top-left. Native x = 2420 + x*2180/1200; native y = y*2180/1200. These are image locations, not angular astronomical measurements.
provenance.ordering: Two composite medallions, then separate stars sorted by y and x; object IDs are local drawing IDs, not ZL numbers.
provenance.scope: Stars form an open field, not a single circular ring; no ring class or clock angle is imposed. Tiny pen flourishes, written glyphs and border ornament are not separate stars. Three six-ray counts are supplied; other point counts remain unclear. The lower disc is described as a diagram rather than guessing a celestial identity.
provenance.limits: One reader; approximate manual centres. No label-text mapping, astronomical identification, or independent rater agreement claimed. The earlier annotation was not inspected.

features.shape: Upper circular medallion: yellow crescent on the left surrounds a pale face; writing follows the outside. This is one composite object, not a separate human figure.
Lower circular medallion: tilted pale face encircled by blue curved petal/flame-like shapes and a pale yellow/brown border. Circular writing outside. No certain sun/moon identity assigned.
Separate multi-pointed radial star drawing in the open field between or beside the two face medallions. A numerical ray count is supplied only where resolved in the native-resolution detail.
